title: S015 媒體類型與寬度的 @media
reproduces: GAPS S015: any @media in a linked stylesheet sent the chapter to the fallback engine, and the parser dropped every block but the dark palette's. This stylesheet has a vendor media type (amzn-kf8) that must not apply, a `screen and (max-width: 512px)` block that applies on a phone-sized page, a `not amzn-kf8` block that applies, and `(hover: hover)` that does not.
